2558-2981-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2981-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

141-3085-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-3967.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

826-1636-6935-8095.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

803-4302-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-4302-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

240-4247-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1477-5131-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

2738-3220-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Golgari Germination, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4186-6822-7687.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4186-6822-7687.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

890-4091-7791.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Palladium Myr.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

1368-4068-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-4068-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

625-1978-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

232-5778-5921-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Fractured Realm.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-5778-5921-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

413-3175-5617.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4518-4986-5686--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kor Skyfisher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kor Skyfisher
Repeat.
4518-4986-5686--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

2281-3817-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

104-261-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1486-1753-4875-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.
1486-1753-4875-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1978-4131-4324.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Workshop Elders.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-3921-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Winding Constrictor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-3921-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1850-4426-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-5412.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1021-1669-4050-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-1669-4050-6761.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-1669-4050-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1580-2438-4871-5111.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

856-2267-5686-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2783-4050-6455.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Dragon Eggs, adding {1}{G}.
When the Dragon Eggs die, they trigger, creating two 2/2 Dragon creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Dragon tokens, adding {2}.
Repeat.

3817-3967-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
3817-3967-5170.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 2.
Repeat.

560-3394-4550-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3394-4550-5147.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

360-1274-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-1274-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-997-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-997-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

198-1651-2645-4824.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least one charge counter on it.
198-1651-2645-4824.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Soliton, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

1284-2922-4136-4831-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2922-4136-4831-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, targeting Cacophodon.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Obscura Storefront from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Obscura Storefront enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Roaring Earth.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cacophodon.
Resolve the Obscura Storefront trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Plains, Island or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Roaring Earth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

746-1778-2106-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mask of Immolation attached to Memnite.
Fighter Class is at least level two.
746-1778-2106-4763.description:
Activate Memnite by sacrificing it.
Memnite dies, triggering Koll, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Memnite ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Mask of Immolation's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

1473-3484-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

2615-3799-4752.notablePrerequisites:
Any land on the battlefield.
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
2615-3799-4752.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, targeting your opponent and setting their life total to 13.
Cast Into the Maw of Hell, destroying any land and dealing 13 damage to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 13 damage to your opponent.

933-2104-2556.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
